data.desc: Ambow Education Holding Ltd. (NYSE American: AMBO) is an AI-driven technology company delivering phygital intelligence solutions for education, enterprise collaboration and live events. Founded in 2000 and headquartered in Cupertino, California, Ambow develops technologies that connect physical environments, artificial intelligence, digital systems, workflows and institutional knowledge. Through HybriU, Ambow enables institutions and professionals to capture, organize, activate and reuse knowledge generated across classrooms, meetings and events, creating intelligence assets that can become more valuable over time.
